app_user_disabled_state_check.name: app_user_disabled_state_check
app_user_disabled_state_check.value: ("app_user"."status" = 'active' AND "app_user"."disabled_at" IS NULL) OR ("app_user"."status" = 'disabled' AND "app_user"."disabled_at" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite("app_user"."disabled_at") AND "app_user"."disabled_at" >= "app_user"."created_at")

user_oidc_identity_revoked_state_check.name: user_oidc_identity_revoked_state_check
user_oidc_identity_revoked_state_check.value: ("user_oidc_identity"."status" = 'active' AND "user_oidc_identity"."revoked_at" IS NULL) OR ("user_oidc_identity"."status" = 'revoked' AND "user_oidc_identity"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite("user_oidc_identity"."revoked_at") AND "user_oidc_identity"."revoked_at" >= "user_oidc_identity"."linked_at")

accounting_document_verification_check.name: accounting_document_verification_check
accounting_document_verification_check.value: isfinite("accounting_document"."created_at") AND ("accounting_document"."verified_at" IS NULL OR isfinite("accounting_document"."verified_at")) AND ("accounting_document"."status" <> 'verified_posted' OR ("accounting_document"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "accounting_document"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL))

journal_entry_storno_check.name: journal_entry_storno_check
journal_entry_storno_check.value: ("journal_entry"."is_storno" OR "journal_entry"."storno_of_entry_id" IS NULL) AND ("journal_entry"."storno_of_entry_id" IS NULL OR "journal_entry"."storno_of_entry_id" <> "journal_entry"."id")

kpir_entry_text_fields_check.name: kpir_entry_text_fields_check
kpir_entry_text_fields_check.value: btrim("kpir_entry"."document_number") <> '' AND btrim("kpir_entry"."counterparty_name") <> '' AND btrim("kpir_entry"."counterparty_address") <> '' AND btrim("kpir_entry"."description") <> '' AND btrim("kpir_entry"."rule_code") <> ''

kpir_entry_storno_consistency_check.name: kpir_entry_storno_consistency_check
kpir_entry_storno_consistency_check.value: ("kpir_entry"."is_storno" OR ("kpir_entry"."storno_of_entry_id" IS NULL AND "kpir_entry"."col7_sales_revenue_grosze" >= 0 AND "kpir_entry"."col8_other_revenue_grosze" >= 0 AND "kpir_entry"."col10_goods_materials_grosze" >= 0 AND "kpir_entry"."col11_incidental_costs_grosze" >= 0 AND "kpir_entry"."col12_remuneration_grosze" >= 0 AND "kpir_entry"."col13_other_expenses_grosze" >= 0 AND "kpir_entry"."rd_cost_grosze" >= 0)) AND ("kpir_entry"."storno_of_entry_id" IS NULL OR "kpir_entry"."storno_of_entry_id" <> "kpir_entry"."id")

mcp_prepared_proposal_lifecycle_check.name: mcp_prepared_proposal_lifecycle_check
mcp_prepared_proposal_lifecycle_check.value: isfinite("mcp_prepared_proposal"."created_at") AND isfinite("mcp_prepared_proposal"."expires_at") AND "mcp_prepared_proposal"."expires_at" > "mcp_prepared_proposal"."created_at" AND (("mcp_prepared_proposal"."status" <> 'confirmed' AND "mcp_prepared_proposal"."confirmed_by" IS NULL AND "mcp_prepared_proposal"."confirmed_at" IS NULL AND "mcp_prepared_proposal"."ledger_entry_id" IS NULL) OR ("mcp_prepared_proposal"."status" = 'confirmed' AND "mcp_prepared_proposal"."confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "mcp_prepared_proposal"."confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND isfinite("mcp_prepared_proposal"."confirmed_at") AND "mcp_prepared_proposal"."ledger_entry_id" IS NOT NULL))

ryczalt_entry_correction_check.name: ryczalt_entry_correction_check
ryczalt_entry_correction_check.value: ("ryczalt_entry"."is_correction" OR ("ryczalt_entry"."revenue_grosze" >= 0 AND "ryczalt_entry"."corrected_entry_id" IS NULL)) AND ("ryczalt_entry"."corrected_entry_id" IS NULL OR "ryczalt_entry"."corrected_entry_id" <> "ryczalt_entry"."id")

settlement_item_amounts_status_check.name: settlement_item_amounts_status_check
settlement_item_amounts_status_check.value: "settlement_item"."original_gross_grosze" > 0 AND "settlement_item"."remaining_gross_grosze" >= 0 AND "settlement_item"."remaining_gross_grosze" <= "settlement_item"."original_gross_grosze" AND (("settlement_item"."status" = 'open' AND "settlement_item"."remaining_gross_grosze" = "settlement_item"."original_gross_grosze") OR ("settlement_item"."status" = 'partial' AND "settlement_item"."remaining_gross_grosze" > 0 AND "settlement_item"."remaining_gross_grosze" < "settlement_item"."original_gross_grosze") OR ("settlement_item"."status" = 'settled' AND "settlement_item"."remaining_gross_grosze" = 0))

settlement_item_timestamps_check.name: settlement_item_timestamps_check
settlement_item_timestamps_check.value: isfinite("settlement_item"."created_at") AND isfinite("settlement_item"."updated_at") AND ("settlement_item"."settled_at" IS NULL OR isfinite("settlement_item"."settled_at"))
